q1.sampleAnswer: My name is Wang Fang. I’m twelve years old. I live in Chengdu, in China. I go on trips two or three times a year, usually with my class. When I go on trips, I usually eat sandwiches and fruit, and sometimes we have a picnic. I would like to go on a trip to Beijing, because I want to see the Great Wall. I haven’t been there before. My dad watches the most TV in my house. He loves watching football. The last time I watched TV was on Sunday evening. I watched a funny film with my family.

keyPoints.descZh: 语法与词汇：简单语法结构的掌握，日常话题词汇的运用
互动交流：回答切题，内容充分，能延展回答
整体表现：能用简单的语言完成交流任务

q1.explanationZh: 好的回答能直接回答每个问题，并多说一两句理由或细节（例如多久出游一次、想去哪里旅行、为什么想去、上次看了什么电视节目），用简单而正确的句子连贯表达。

q2.sampleAnswer: I don’t like tidying up, because it’s boring, but I know it’s important. I love playing games at home, like chess, because it’s fun to play with my brother. Chatting with friends is nice, because we can talk about school and music. I don’t think reading magazines is exciting, but I like looking at the pictures. I think cooking is a bit hard, but I like helping my mum make dumplings. I like playing games best. I prefer going out at the weekend, because I can meet my friends in the park. At home, I like spending time with my sister, because we play games and watch films together.

q2.explanationZh: 好的回答会对图中每种在家做的活动（整理房间、玩游戏、聊天、看杂志、做饭）说出喜不喜欢并给出理由，能回答考官的追问，说出最喜欢哪一种，比较在家和周末出门，并用 because 等连接词展开。
